items.stem: An activity shows total float of zero but is not on the longest path reported by P6. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: A constraint or calendar is driving the activity, not network logic
options.rationale: Correct: constraints and calendars can produce zero float independently of the longest logic path.

options.text: P6 cannot show float for constrained activities
options.rationale: P6 does compute float for constrained activities; the value is simply affected by the constraint.
Missing predecessors affects float but would not by itself force it to zero off the critical path.

options.text: Total float is always zero for every activity
options.rationale: Total float varies across the network; it is not universally zero.

items.explanation: Correct: constraints and calendars can produce zero float independently of the longest logic path.

items.stem: During a progress update you want a reliable earned-value picture. Which TWO actions are required? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Advance the data date to the status date before reading SPI/CPI
options.rationale: Correct: earned-value indices are meaningless unless the data date reflects the as-of point.

options.text: Record actual progress against the current baseline
options.rationale: Correct: EV compares actual progress to the baseline, so a baseline must be assigned and progress recorded.
Deleting the baseline removes the reference EV is measured against.

options.text: Set every remaining activity to 100% complete
options.rationale: Marking unfinished work complete falsifies the status and the indices.

items.explanation: Correct: earned-value indices are meaningless unless the data date reflects the as-of point.

items.stem: A project board wants a one-page view of what is at risk in the next month. Which P6 output best fits?

options.text: A filtered layout of near-critical activities in the next 30 days, grouped by responsibility
options.rationale: Correct: a filtered, grouped layout targets the board's decision horizon.

options.text: The full activity table exported to a spreadsheet
options.rationale: The full table buries the signal the board needs in detail.

options.text: A resource histogram for the whole project
options.rationale: A whole-project histogram does not isolate the next month's risk.

options.text: The raw baseline with no progress applied
options.rationale: A baseline without progress shows the plan, not current risk.

items.explanation: Correct: a filtered, grouped layout targets the board's decision horizon.
